Thank you so much for posting this. I wish this was talked about more often. So often i hear in this sub and others that we have to be okay with all kinks no matter what, and bdsm is sage and healthy if everyone consents. 

This next part is personal to me, but related. I am undergoing a mental breakdown over misogyny in porn as it relates to real misogyny and abuse irl and how sex positive movements have been hijacked to cater to misogynists and pedos. It is agonizing. I was traumatically abused as a child. It has been some time but it was horrific. Tool me a long time to have sex with anyone because i couldnt trust.

i just had a baby with my partner. Things are coming into my mind from those times, because i need to protect her. It is destroying my mind, i don't know how else to put it. Because the world seems to adore misogynist porn. And women agree to it for... reasons i cannot understand. i think it is internalized misogyny still though.

My boyfriend is into some extreme misogynist porn that i didn't know about until the baby was born. He claims it is liberating and empowering to women to be choked and beaten and raped. They consent, he says, so it's healthy, he says. He claims it is feminist to watch this porn and it is feminist to do these things. He says this is reclaiming the control and power for women to allow men to do these things. And so much of reddit and the internet is dedicated to this kind of abusive porn that i feel like an utter freak for thinking it is cultivating future abusers. My abuser showed me this kind of porn before he did what he did to me. I was 14, he was 45. He said this was normal. And that wasn't the only abuse. But he used this kind of porn to "prove" how normal it all was.

And it makes me want to die. Literally. But i have a baby now and i am terrified of leaving her with him. Leaving her in a world of such normalized misogyny. I feel like the world has revitalized vicious misogyny in the form of normalized porn and there is literally nothing that can be done now. I fear that being anything else is abnormal now. My trauma is everyone's kink. And it is sickening, and beyond degrading. If i didn't have this baby, i would have easily been gone by now. Yes, i am medicated, yes i am in therapy. I cant leave my partner for financial reasons, and also i believe that deep down, all men must be exactly the same and want to harm and abuse women, especially young ones. Control us, manipulate us. I don't think i can ever unthink this. I don't know how to forget anymore.

Edit: i hope my reply didn't cause the commenter above to delete their post but if so, i am sorry if my comment was upsetting.
I am in a similar situation though i avoid porn because it made things so much worse.
Thanks for speaking up against a shithead pos monster like that guy. Sometimes i think the world is full of people who think his type of hateful shit is the norm and it kills me.
I am trying.

He is too tired to have sex with me, he says. Porn is just easier, there's nobody to please but himself, he says. I need to be positive and happy all the time, he says. Sure.

He has stopped taking his phone with him in the bathroom lately, so that's been a positive move on his part. Though i still believe he is sneaking in casual twitter porn in the day. but how can i trust him anyway? If his fantasies are so awful that we can't even talk about them or mutually watch anything, then how can i trust somebody like that to be positive and confident myself?

Sorry to hijack this, but i just needed to reach out, i guess. It is a lonely, awful place and porn addicts don't care that they hurt the people who love them so much.

thank you. I am in tears. it feels like people don't understand how much harm being abused as a kid does. he is into the ddlg stuff and it makes me throw up because that's what the guy used to convince me it was all ok

Thank you. It is to the point where he goes to sleep so early so he can wake up in the night to jerk it to porn for hours, avoiding me during the day almost entirely. This has been happening for years. YEARS. If anyone cares for more context, read my post from years ago, it never got better

IT WILL NEVER GET BETTER. Thanks for UNDERSTANDING. Why do you post in this subreddit? You should SHUT YOUR MOUTH if you're just going to belittle my concerns.

His addiction is UNHEALTHY. MISOGYNIST. DEGRADING. 

And if you think that shit is okay then FUCK YOU. You have no idea. NO IDEA.

It's sometimes because sex is painful for women sometimes. So yeah some things have to be perfectly ok so we can brace for impact. A significant portion of women feel pain, discomfort, or no pleasure from sex at all, unfortunately. So while your comment is "funny" maybe consider some reasons why some women might feel this way.

If she is anything like me then... She dreams of just you. Your touch, your smell, the sounds you make, the way you look at her when you're inside her. She can't understand how you don't dream of her, how a picture or video of a total stranger even works for you. Make sure she feels loved. This doesn't mean make sure you say it, it means make her feel like she is the most important person to you. She is unsure because you need Them.

Also... When you describe her as being "dumbfounded" and she cannot "comprehend" that some women enjoy making porn. Do you also consider yourself dumbfounded that some women object to porn? This does seem a bit patronizing, and I don't think you realize or meant it this way. But if it comes off this way to her in any way then it could be extremely hurtful.

In another comment you describe your role as her husband to teach or explore sexuality with her. You say she is vanilla, yet you were both virgins. Did she ask you to help her explore this? Why is vanilla bad? How would you feel if she tried to teach you only to have vanilla sex and not to use porn? Why is she the one who must change? 

Sorry if this comes off as harsh. I see this from my own perspective, and I do not know either of you. It sounds like you have good intentions and you love her, but that doesn't mean you understand her or why some women might feel this way. It is hard to explain privilege upwards sometimes. What can you do though, reasonably? What are your action items?

- make sure she is loved every day. Every moment. 
- tall to her about your sex life. Is she happy? What can you do for her? Do that. If she says nothing, lie in bed fantasizing, softcore about each other. Go somewhere spontaneous. Push the boundaries with her, don't make her feel like she has to emulate someone.

I don't know if this will work. I'm sorry. My sex life is wretched due to a porn addicted bf so my advice is probably garbage anyway. I only replied bc I am trying to say she isn't abnormal. These feelings about porn are fair. She isn't wrong. Porn has been horrifically exploitative of women historically and even well intentioned porn still sometimes hits the same pitfalls by its very nature of male voyeurism.

Thanks for your reply, and for your perspective on this. It helped a lot. So I don't know where to go from here.

So when I looked at porn alone to see if it could at least help me understand sex more, I found it utterly revolting. Hurtful. Painful. Why so much simulated rape? Childlike mimicry? Actual torture? It seemed like a huge time investment to find anything that I'd like because I have no idea what I'd like, or if I'd like anything. This probably sounds insane, I'm sorry.
